messages:
sarah (eng-security): Heads up — we're seeing sustained 429s from GCP KMS in us-west1 for envelope decrypts starting ~09:12 UTC. Not customer-facing yet, but retries spiked and latency climbed. kms-monitor posted alerts.

kms-monitor: ALERT KMS_API_THROTTLE us-west1 rate=118/min baseline=18/min window=60s :rotating_light:

tom (eng-sre): On it. Which service is the biggest emitter?

sarah (eng-security): service-auth & service-embed both show decrypt attempts up. I pulled a quick tail of logs — snippet below.

elena (eng-infra): log paste:
```
2026-05-10T09:12:34Z service-auth decrypt status=429 attempt=1 request_id=xyz
2026-05-10T09:12:34Z service-auth decrypt status=429 attempt=2 request_id=xyz
2026-05-10T09:12:35Z service-auth fallback=ENVELOPE_CACHE hit=true dek_id=dek-abc123
2026-05-10T09:12:36Z service-auth decrypt status=200 attempt=3 latency=340ms
```

elena (eng-infra): Also saw dek-cache hit-rate drop from 98% -> 71% in the same minute. Could be a cache eviction storm or simultaneous invalidation.

tom (eng-sre): Current client retry is linear 200ms x3. That's not great for a KMS throttling storm. Propose: 1) bump to exponential backoff with jitter (200ms, 800ms, 2.4s) 2) enable circuit-breaker after N consecutive 429s 3) short TTL increase for local envelope cache.

sarah (eng-security): Agreed. Also we have a key rotation scheduled later today for the same keyring — I'm recommending we pause rotation until we stabilize. Rotation could trigger more cache misses.

luis (security): +1 pause rotation. We should also verify audit logging for decrypt failures — want to be sure we capture all 429/timeout events for compliance.

ops-oncall: Quick mitigation step I can do now: increase envelope-cache TTL from 5m -> 30m for affected services and temporarily route retries to us-central1 KMS key replica if needed. Any objections?

tom (eng-sre): Do it. Add jitter to retry code path and deploy a config change flag so we can flip it back. I'll assemble a tiny canary rollout to 10% traffic first.

elena (eng-infra): I'll validate cache TTL change won't cause memory pressure on pods. If it does, we can use redis-side cache fallback instead.

sarah (eng-security): Good. For audit/compliance: add a dedicated log stream for KMS throttle events (gcp-kms/throttle) and ensure logs are exported to long-term storage + SIEM. Luis, can you own that?

luis (security): I can own it. I'll create the log sink and a KQL alert in the SIEM for repeated 429 patterns.

tom (eng-sre): Action items: 1) ops-oncall increase cache TTL (in-flight) 2) tom -> update retry/backoff + canary (PR opened) 3) elena -> monitor memory and switch to redis if needed 4) sarah/luis -> pause rotation + add audit sink 5) create incident ticket + update runbook.

ops-oncall: Cache TTL update pushed to staging, rolling to prod now.

kms-monitor: NOTE: throttle rate dropped to 22/min after first mitigation window.

sarah (eng-security): Nice. Reconfirming pause on rotation — moved to manual hold by security.

tom (eng-sre): PR for backoff/jitter: https://git.internal/r/redwood/service-auth/pull/498 (canary 10% -> 100% if stable). Will link metrics.

elena (eng-infra): Observability check: dek-cache hit-rate recovering to ~95% after cache TTL bump. Memory impact minimal so far.

luis (security): Audit sink created: projects/redwood-logging/sinks/gcp-kms-throttle-sink. SIEM alert rule created.

sarah (eng-security): Great. We'll run a short postmortem/near-miss writeup if anything customer-facing occurs. Opening a tracking ticket: INC-2341 (internal). Assigning to tom and elena for follow-ups.

tom (eng-sre): I'll update the KMS runbook with a new section: "GCP KMS throttling — exponential backoff, local envelope-cache TTL, cross-region fallback" and link the config flags.

ops-oncall: Leaving the on-call note: if we see >50 429/min for >3 min, hit the page and failover to us-central1 key replica.

sarah (eng-security): Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: postmortem template in #postmortems, runbook PR by EOD, and rotation remains paused until we give the green light.

kms-monitor: STATUS clear — rate=8/min.

tom (eng-sre): Closing the thread — will update INC-2341 as we get metrics from the canary.
